sources.contract: Canonical physical scalar/vector, mean and soil inputs use final-owner Block_Data. Completed physical temperature/velocity/soil results are retained there; mass, means, pole velocities and atmospheric wavelets are preserved.

Atmospheric aliases use the saved final-inverse consumer epoch; mean/soil references are captured at initial RK entry. Physics updates retain alias temperature/velocity/soil. Readiness and closure guards prevent stale or canonical access.
block_catalog supplies final owner, global root Domain and subtree patch identity.
Original local column traversal and pole order are preserved.

Import column keys and explicit alias/reference inputs to execution owners; fetch canonical atmospheric, mean and soil values from native storage owners. Compile source-local predecessor identities into DAG waves; compute hydrostatics, kinetic energy and package updates on owners. Exchange only required updated edges, preserving entry aliases. Publish completed double-precision state once. Fixed scaffold remains an explicit compatibility case.
init_physics initializes parameters, geometry and extra-level contract on every rank. physics_checkpoint_restart is empty; do not assume it allocates package arrays.
Before every non-first call, reload Tsurf/Tsoil from the packet; after every call, return them. Reload latitude/longitude and trigonometric geometry for every column.

firstcall_alloc is rank-local and private. firstcall is per-column epoch semantics: preserve it in the packet. Late first use initializes via a disposable first-call copy before the requested non-first call. icount and zDay_last have no numerical consumers in this package.
Tsurf/Tsoil are mutable package scratch; dz1/dz2 and surface property arrays are initialized geometry/parameters. Soil state travels in each packet.
Radiative inputs and outputs are recomputed per call; no saved column tendency cache.
Saved members are model constants/parameters; numerical column work arrays are local.
Orbit constants are initialized per rank; SolarLon/Orbite compute from the supplied time.
Location arrays are rank-local mutable scratch, overwritten for every dispatched column.
Native physical/soil updates and compatibility publication precede soil wavelets and adaptation. The pending phase and atmospheric wavelet decision image remain intact.

route: Column and edge native keys are sent to execution owners, which request canonical data directly from storage owners. Global metadata defines predecessor edges by source Domain/node, ordinal and block. Only required updated velocity components are exchanged.
source_identity: Each of six operands carries local node ID, expected writer ordinal, and catalogue index where covered. Zero identifies a saved atmospheric consumer alias; its mean/soil reference adapter remains explicit. Do not replace entry aliases with newer canonical values.
transport: Bulk owner-local packets and double-precision raw inputs. Topological waves execute ready columns; targeted all-to-all edge updates carry producer components. Bulk double-precision results return to a write-only compatibility callback.
limits: Owner-resident epoch and DAG replace per-column Domain reads/writes during execution. Canonical atmospheric/mean/soil reads use owner storage; atmospheric aliases use saved native consumer values. The bounded initial alias reference import and final publication still use Domain compatibility storage; physics itself reads native entry operands and retains complete physical/soil results. Persistent adaptation and I/O migration remain required.
package_audit: Manual source review; scientific equivalence is additionally checked by exact trajectory and per-column owner-output oracles.
